accounts.label: likely_genuine
accounts.rationale: Very low pass-through ratio and a tainted share of about 1.6% in a business account aged over 588 days strongly suggest this is a genuine account that absorbed the funds. No device or phone links to known mules support this conclusion.

verdicts.reason: The lien of Rs 199,570.03 targets only the victim's traceable funds still in the account (tainted share ~1.6% of a Rs 12.3M balance), so it does not freeze the account holder's own money. Although the account appears genuine (low pass-through, 588-day age, business account, no mule links), it demonstrably received Rs 205,619.40 of the victim's stolen funds and retains most of them.
